name: ink pen
description: Nib and bottle ink: the line swells on the downstroke, pools where the nib stopped, and cross-hatching ignores where the light is.

prompt.default: nib pen and black ink: contours that swell on the downstroke and taper to a point, ink pooling where the nib rested, cross-hatching that ignores the light
prompt.flux: a nib pen drawing in black ink, contours swelling on the downstroke and tapering to a hair, small ink pools where the nib paused, cross-hatched shadow laid on regardless of the light
prompt.sdxl: ink pen drawing, black ink, line weight variation, cross hatching, ink pool, high contrast line art
